title: Исход 37 — Exodus 37
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) takes the genitive → акации.

cases.sentence: Он покрыл его чистым ___ внутри и снаружи.
cases.translation: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside.
cases.explain: The material used to cover it (покрыл) is expressed by the instrumental → золотом.

cases.sentence: Он отлил для него четыре золотых ___.
cases.translation: He cast four gold rings for it.
cases.explain: After the numerals два/три/четыре the noun takes the genitive singular → кольца.

cases.sentence: Он вложил шесты в кольца на обеих ___ ковчега.
cases.translation: He put the poles into the rings on both sides of the ark.
cases.explain: The preposition на meaning "on" a location takes the prepositional → сторонах (prepositional plural).

cases.sentence: Он сделал крышку ___ из чистого золота.
cases.translation: He made the mercy seat (cover of atonement) of pure gold.
cases.explain: The qualifying "of atonement" is expressed by the genitive → искупления.

cases.sentence: Херувимы простирали ___ вверх, закрывая ими крышку.
cases.translation: The cherubim spread their wings upward, covering the cover with them.
cases.explain: Крылья is the direct object of простирали (spread out); for an inanimate plural the accusative equals the nominative → крылья.

cases.sentence: Они были обращены друг к другу лицом к ___.
cases.translation: They were turned toward one another, facing the cover.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) takes the dative → крышке.

cases.sentence: На всю эту утварь ушёл один ___ чистого золота.
cases.translation: A single talent of pure gold went into all this equipment.
cases.explain: Талант is the subject of ушёл (was used up), so it takes the nominative → талант.

reading.ru: Веселил сделал ковчег из акации, два с половиной локтя в длину, полтора локтя в ширину и полтора в высоту.
reading.question: What did Bezalel make from acacia wood, and how long was it?
options: The ark, two and a half cubits long
reading.correct: The ark, two and a half cubits long
reading.explain: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.

reading.ru: Он покрыл его чистым золотом внутри и снаружи и сделал вокруг него золотой ободок, отлил для него четыре золотых кольца и укрепил их на его нижних углах, по два с каждой стороны.
reading.question: How did he overlay the ark?
options: With pure gold inside and outside
With silver on the outside only
reading.correct: With pure gold inside and outside
reading.explain: He overlaid the ark with pure gold both inside and outside and made a gold molding around it.

reading.ru: Херувимы простирали крылья вверх, закрывая ими крышку искупления, и были обращены друг к другу лицом к крышке.
reading.question: How were the cherubim positioned?
options: Wings spread upward, covering the mercy seat, facing one another
Facing outward away from each other
reading.correct: Wings spread upward, covering the mercy seat, facing one another
reading.explain: The cherubim spread their wings upward, covering the mercy seat, and faced one another toward the cover.

reading.ru: Он сделал светильник из чистого золота, выковал его, его основание и ножку, а его чашечки, бутоны и лепестки составляли одно целое.
reading.question: From what and how was the lampstand made?
options: Of pure gold, hammered as one piece
Of bronze cast in a mold
reading.correct: Of pure gold, hammered as one piece
reading.explain: He made the lampstand of pure gold, hammered so that its base, shaft, cups, buds, and flowers were one piece.

reading.ru: На всю эту утварь ушел один талант чистого золота.
reading.question: How much pure gold went into all this equipment?
reading.explain: One talent of pure gold was used for the lampstand and all its equipment.

reading.ru: Из акации он сделал жертвенник для возжигания благовоний.
reading.question: From what wood did he make the altar of incense?
reading.explain: He made the altar for burning incense out of acacia wood.
